item.title: Governor Hochul Announces New Study Highlighting New York’s Position as a National Leader in Quantum Technology
item.description: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Governor Kathy Hochul today announced the release of a comprehensive study of New York State’s quantum technology landscape, finding that the Empire State ranks second nationally in quantum-related businesses, research groups and patents. item.title: IQM and Telefónica Plan Quantum Computer for Madrid University
item.description: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Telefónica and IQM Quantum Computers, a global leader in superconducting quantum computing, have joined forces to deploy the first quantum computer in the Community of Madrid. The initiative will strengthen the region’s scientific and technological capabilities, while driving the development of real-world cases for companies across the Community of Madrid. […]
